name: Cooldown Bars (Example)
author: MarshalX
description: A draining bar for every ability you have on cooldown, soonest ready first, with an exact one for anything regenerating a charge. Draws as a column of named bars or as a strip of swept icons.

preview.alt: The Cooldowns panel, five draining bars ordered by time remaining: Rapid Fire 4.4s, Volley 5.8s, Counter Shot 10.4s, Wildheart 97.5s and Shellskin 155.5s, each with the ability's own icon.

settings.label: Most bars to show at once
Hide cooldowns shorter than the global cooldown
